title: Synthesis, Characterization, Antitumor Potential, BSA and DNA Binding Properties, and Molecular Docking Study of Some Novel 3-Hydroxy-3- Pyrrolin-2-Ones.
authors: Joksimovic, Nenad; Petronijevic, Jelena; Milovic, Emilija; Jankovic, Nenad; Baskic, Dejan; Popovic, Suzana; Todorovic, Danijela; Matic, Sanja; Vranes, Milan; Tot, Aleksandar
one_liner_zh: 该研究合成并表征新型3-羟基-3-吡咯啉-2-酮类化合物，评估其抗肿瘤活性及与DNA/BSA的结合性质，并辅以分子对接预测结合模式，但核心是药物小分子与DNA的相互作用，而非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，方法上仅简单分子对接，缺乏AI或物理模拟深度。
abstract: BACKGROUND: In order to make progress in discovering the new agents for cancer treatment with improved properties and considering the fact that 3-hydroxy-3-pyrrolin-2-ones belong to a class of biologically active compounds, we tested series of eleven novels 1,5-diaryl-4-(2- thienylcarbonyl)-3-hydroxy-3-pyrrolin-2-ones for their antitumor potential. METHODS: All novel compounds were characterized by spectral (IR, NMR, MS) and elemental analysis. All novel 3-hydroxy-3-pyrrolin-2-ones were screened for their cytotoxic activity on two cancer cell lines, SW480 and MDA-MB 231, and non-transformed fibroblasts (MRC-5). RESULTS: Compounds B8, B9, and B10 showed high cytotoxicity on SW480 cells together with good selectivity towards MRC-5 cells. It is important to empathize that the degree of selectivity of B8 and B10 was high (SI = 5.54 and 12.09, respectively). Besides, we explored the mechanisms of cytotoxicity of novel derivatives, B8, B9, and B10. The assay showed that tested derivatives induce an apoptotic type of cell death in SW480 cells, with a minor percent of necrotic cells. Additionally, to better understand the suitability of the compounds for potential use as anticancer medicaments, we studied their interactions with biomacromolecules (DNA or BSA). The results indicated that the tested compounds have a great affinity to displace EB from the EB-DNA complex through intercalation. Also, DNA and BSA molecular docking study was performed to predict the binding mode and the interaction region of the compounds. CONCLUSION: Achieved results indicate that our compounds have the potential to become candidates for use as medicaments.
abstract_zh: 背景：为了在发现具有改进性能的新型抗癌药物方面取得进展，并考虑到3-羟基-3-吡咯啉-2-酮属于一类生物活性化合物，我们测试了十一种新型1,5-二芳基-4-(2-噻吩甲酰基)-3-羟基-3-吡咯啉-2-酮的抗肿瘤潜力。方法：所有新型化合物均通过光谱（IR、NMR、MS）和元素分析进行表征。所有新型3-羟基-3-吡咯啉-2-酮均在两种癌细胞系SW480和MDA-MB 231以及非转化成纤维细胞（MRC-5）上筛选了其细胞毒性活性。结果：化合物B8、B9和B10对SW480细胞表现出高细胞毒性，同时对MRC-5细胞具有良好的选择性。重要的是要强调，B8和B10的选择性程度较高（SI分别为5.54和12.09）。此外，我们探讨了新型衍生物B8、B9和B10的细胞毒性机制。检测表明，所测试的衍生物在SW480细胞中诱导凋亡型细胞死亡，伴有少量坏死细胞。另外，为了更好地理解这些化合物作为潜在抗癌药物的适用性，我们研究了它们与生物大分子（DNA或BSA）的相互作用。结果表明，所测试的化合物通过嵌入方式具有从EB-DNA复合物中置换EB的强亲和力。同时，进行了DNA和BSA分子对接研究，以预测化合物的结合模式和相互作用区域。结论：所获得的结果表明，我们的化合物有潜力成为用作药物的候选物。
